title: Thank You For Your Inquiry: College Student
content:
Thank You for Scheduling With Us!

Please read the information below before attending the discovery meeting.

What to Expect During the Discovery Meeting

Hi, we’re Amy and Sheryl and we look forward to meeting with you.

About Us

We’re LSA’s Client Support Specialists. One of us will be your guide through the first steps with Life Skills Advocate.

Our role is to create a supportive, empathetic space and make sure you have the information you need to feel comfortable and confident.

You will receive a calendar invitation from one of us shortly, including a Zoom link.

If you do not see it, please contact us at:

For Amy: amy.kim.waschke@lifeskillsadvocate.com or by calling or texting +1 206-588-5013

For Sheryl: sheryl.janosky@lifeskillsadvocate.com or by calling or texting +1 425-522-2628

We’re looking forward to meeting with you!

General Overview of the Discovery Meeting

1

Welcome 😃

Introduce yourself and learn how coaching with LSA may be able to help.

2

Goals 🎯

Discuss your goals and expectations to customize your coaching experience.

3

Overview 🔍

Discover more about our coaching process and how it can benefit you.

4

Next Steps ✔️

Get paired with the right coach & book a complimentary first session.

3 Things to Help You Prepare

All links below open in new browser tabs.

1

Zoom Settings & Meeting Recording

Before our meeting, please test your Zoom setup using this link. We record and transcribe meetings using Fathom to help us focus and provide thorough follow-ups, all in line with our privacy policy. These recordings may be shared with your future coach to better prepare for working together.If you prefer not to have the meeting recorded, please inform Amy before the meeting by emailing amy.kim.waschke@lifeskillsadvocate.com or mention it at the start of the session.

2

Explore Our FAQ Page

While we're eager to address all your questions in our meeting, you can also get a head start by visiting our FAQ page. This resource might provide immediate answers to some questions you may have about our service.

3

If You Need to Cancel or Reschedule...

Please use the cancel or reschedule link at the bottom of the confirmation email you just received.

If you don't see it or need help, please reach out to amy.kim.waschke@lifeskillsadvocate.com.
